profile_text.body:
Intel Corp is a public company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, trading on the ticker INTC and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000050863. Its website presents the company under the tagline "Intel Inside - Built for AI," and describes its offering as delivering AI at scale across cloud, data center, edge, and client through hardware and software solutions. The site also notes that Fortune has recognized Intel's innovations in AI, computing, and semiconductor manufacturing.

The company's own framing places AI at the center of its positioning, with the stated aim of supporting AI workloads across several computing environments rather than a single segment. Beyond that description, the material available does not name specific products or detail particular AI offerings.

Litigation records for the company list 270 cases in California. No individual cases are identified in the available material.
